A0.stop_rule: a non-certified point stops the campaign for review

A1.best_node_and_duration: argmin over the 2025 ladders of F(x) = I(x) + Q(x) (corrected cost file); ties -> lower I(x)

ladders_2025.note: each node alone, others zero; E in {1..5} MWh at 2 h (P = E/2) and 4 h (P = E/4); budget not applied

A1.outputs: value-of-storage curves Q(0) - Q(x) against I(x) per node and duration; the timing curve at the best node; the budget marked
A1.year_ladder: investment years 2030 and 2035 at the best node, E in {1..5}, BOTH durations: 20 points. Planner reading recorded: Addendum 27 and STEP4 section 4.1 state 20 points 'at the best node and duration only'; two years x five energies at one duration is 10, and SRP1 has no other investment years, so the stated count implies both durations - flagged for the A1 review

A2: the best single-node setting per node combined in a 2^|N| presence design (4 new points); staging at the best node (half in 2025 + half in 2030; full in 2030) - 2 points; C* rounded to the lattice (1.0 MVA / 4.0 MWh at all nodes) - 1 point
A3: resolution probe folded into A1's best ladder: unit-step points (E at 0.5 MWh steps around the budget-feasible levels; one P step at fixed E), about 4 points; the largest non-monotone jump in Q along the ladder relative to the smooth trend is the measured sigma_Q, replacing the provisional 1.1e-4
authority: STEP4_DFO_METHOD.md (updated to Addendum 27; untracked author/expert file)

configuration.oracle: AA-on keep_memory, adopted (Addendum 27): anderson_acceleration = {enabled: true, memory: 5, regularization: 1e-10, reject_policy: keep_memory} written into data/SRP1/SRP1_params.json; everything else as the D case file (fb3de341)
configuration.record: the AA saving falls with storage size (23/17/21/4 % at C*/paper plan/node-7-empty/2xC*); both cycle predictions missed - memory loss was not the main limit on AA
configuration.reverification_gate: a case-file-alone C* evaluation through the campaign harness (no overrides) reproduces the committed AA C* evaluation (campaign_s44_aa_variant, 107 cycles, 650,982,939.9389359) bitwise on every numeric trajectory field and cost; tie-order in the recourse-jump top-10 classified with p515_s44_tie_classifier; provenance non-gating

execution.barrier: non-certified evaluations recorded with cause; in A0 a non-certified point stops the campaign; in A1-A3 a run of barrier points in a region stops for review
execution.cache: keyed by canonical x; a cache hit never re-evaluates

paper_scale_task.a: pristine snapshot clones switchable, OFF for campaign and verification runs, default unchanged; bitwise gate at SRP1 (clones off vs on, 2 cycles)
paper_scale_task.b: the four single-scenario code paths generalized (p56a_oracle.load_baseline hard-wired to SRP1.json; run_admm_arm's 51 solves per cycle; scenario-(0,0) reads; the prob_market_scenarios overwrite per the audit); SRP1 behaviour bitwise unchanged
paper_scale_task.c: re-measure the paper-scale build with clones off and TIME ONE CYCLE, run alone (no campaign concurrently); watchdog 24 GiB
paper_scale_task.provisional_design: search on SRP1; paper-scale evaluation of the final incumbent serially with snapshots off; confirmed or revised on the timed cycle

phase_B: follows A1 under a separate frozen spec (v16) naming the cost-file hash, the budget, the lattice, the configuration and the poll design, per STEP4_DFO_METHOD.md 5; single-cohort first; the general lattice only if a staging probe at the incumbent shows staging helps
